description: This file defines a custom file filter class 'UserProfileFileFilter' used for filtering '.xml' files associated with 'ECU Logger User Profiles' in a Java application. It extends the FileFilter class and utilizes the GenericFileFilter for specific filtering logic.

classes.name: UserProfileFileFilter
classes.description: A final class extending Java's FileFilter, providing filtering for 'xml' files related to ECU Logger User Profiles.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether a given File is accepted by this filter, delegating to the wrapped GenericFileFilter.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the filter, delegating to the wrapped GenericFileFilter.
